# Closing the books in two days

Published 2026-10-06 by the Orbit Ledger team.

Until this month, our customers spent an average of six working days on month-end close. Most of that time went into matching bank lines to invoices by hand.

Today we are releasing Auto-Match, which pairs bank transactions with open invoices as soon as they arrive. In our beta with 40 finance teams, the median close dropped from six days to two.

Auto-Match is available on every plan from today, with no setup.
voice_samples:
We shipped something small this week that saves a lot of clicks.

Invoices now remember the last tax rate you used. That's it. That's the post.

#fintech

Month-end shouldn't feel like a fire drill.

We talked to 25 controllers this quarter. Every one of them had a spreadsheet they were afraid to close.

We're working on that.

Short version: exports are 3x faster now.

Longer version: we rewrote the export pipeline so it streams instead of batching. If you export big ledgers, you'll feel it.
